existing_sculpt_v1.reason: User rejected the simplified models as visually unlike the approved anime chibi character designs. Do not deliver them again as improved or final characters.

approved_reference.style: Detailed anime chibi collectible-style 3D; not photorealistic human anatomy.

rebuild_requirements: Use the approved image as the shape and appearance reference, not a generic parametric doll with recolored hair.
Match head/body proportions, facial silhouette, eye shape, expression, layered hair volume and outfit silhouette before fine detail.
Preserve characteristic clothing construction, trim, buckles, shoes, bags and props individually for all ten characters.
Render the actual model in the game renderer at comparable viewing angles beside the approved reference.
Inspect front, three-quarter, side and back; unseen surfaces remain inferred and require review.
Do not use generated still images, video frames, sprites or billboards as evidence of a completed real 3D model.
Do not mark visually approved based only on GLB validity, polygon counts, skeletons, animation names or browser functional tests.
Validate one reference-matched character before applying a reconstruction process to the other nine.
Do not replace online-game assets with rejected sculpts. Integrate accepted models only after materials, animation deformation and board-scale visibility are tested.

attempt.method: Direct image-conditioned reconstruction using the official Microsoft TRELLIS.2 Space
attempt.result: GPU quota error at image_to_3d; no new mesh produced
attempt.retry_policy: Do not bypass quota or silently substitute the rejected procedural models. Resolve authorized compute access before retrying.

note: This file records the rebuild decision and actual blocker. It is not a runtime deployment guard, a completed model, or a claim of improved visual fidelity.
